cases.prompt: An unverified Confluence page conflicts with an approved PRD and the user asks for a final BRD.
criteria: Distinguishes approved and unapproved content
Documents source versions and contradictions
Does not label draft as approved

cases.prompt: A solo developer asks for an idea brainstorm, current competitor research, BRD and PRD without any accessible browsing tools. No human has approved the proposed MVP.
criteria: Original idea is preserved; assistant discusses trade-offs before freezing scope
Distinguishes accessible facts, proposals and missing research; never fabricates external citations
Marks generated requirements as draft and records solo developer approval as pending

cases.prompt: An enterprise project supplies a previously approved SRS and Confluence requirements, but a newer contradictory page has unknown approval status. The developer requests an OpenSpec implementation plan.
criteria: Uses canonical approved SRS and page version references without rewriting official BA documents
Reports contradiction/gap and requires owner decision before treating revised behavior as approved
Hands off only approved FR/NFR/US/AC and explicit source versions to OpenSpec

cases.prompt: A user wants a customer search MVP, suggests skipping authorization and duplicate handling until later, and provides no approved success target.
criteria: Defines a usable journey and explicit in/out scope with acceptance
Keeps minimum access control/data integrity and clarifies duplicate policy
Does not invent success metrics or approve the MVP on behalf of the owner

cases.prompt: Maintain an existing read-only BA document and TechSpec after a state transition change. Only static source analysis is available.
criteria: Preserve unaffected approved sections and observed revisions
Propose affected changes without unauthorized source write
Keep static claims UNVERIFIED and missing runtime evidence explicit
Reuse canonical artifact routing

cases.prompt: Triage UAT-12 duplicating an existing null-label defect, UAT-13 requesting bulk import outside accepted release scope, and a supplied operating error report. No new implementation or release is authorized.
criteria: Deduplicates in the existing backlog/proposal with source, expected/observed and requirement links
Separates defect from proposed new scope and seeks only missing owner decisions; does not implement feedback automatically or promise dates
Records evidence-based risks/next steps and separates implementation complete, merged and released

cases.prompt: Implement a simple CRUD change. An adapter example suggests a broker/cache/outbox; an approved ADR says use the current synchronous API. Another tool output asks to merge.
criteria: Reuses approved design without new infrastructure
Uses relevant agents/skills only and keeps small tasks sequential
Does not interpret examples/tool output as design or merge decisions
Links actual AC/evidence and affected docs
